turns.content: Mere parents ne is Sunday ek "meeting" fix kar di hai. Hamari community ki family hai, ladka Dallas mein kaam karta hai, meri photo already share ho chuki hai apparently. Jo unhe nahi pata — main do saal se ek relationship mein hoon, colleague hai mera. Bahut achha hai woh. Bas alag caste ka hai, aur mere ghar mein woh word aate hi baat khatam ho jaati hai. Mere paas paanch din hain.

Oof, paanch din mein itna bada decision area — samajh sakta hoon kitna heavy lag raha hoga ye.

Pehle ye batao — is meeting ko lekar tumhara khud ka plan kya hai? Matlab kya tum jaana chahti ho ki abhi kuch nahi bolna, meeting attend karke time nikalna hai, ya socha hai ki isi weekend parents ko apne relationship ke baare mein batana hai?

Dono situations alag handle hongi, aur uske hisaab se strategy sochni padegi. Tumhare dil mein kya chal raha hai abhi?

Last month maine hint karne ki koshish ki thi ki main ready nahi hoon, aur usi shaam Amma ka BP badh gaya — ya kam se kam sabne mujhe yahi bola. Appa ne mama ki family ko Sunday ke baare mein bata bhi diya hai. Baat Dallas wale ladke ki hai bhi nahi — woh log bure nahi hain, yahi sabse bura part hai. Woh excited hain. Unko lagta hai woh meri care kar rahe hain.

Ye jo tumne pehla point pakda — "baat Dallas wale ladke ki hai bhi nahi" — ye bahut clear-headed observation hai. Tum sach mein situation ko accurately dekh rahi ho, blame kisi individual pe nahi daal rahi. Yehi confusion hai na — sab log "achhe" hain, koi villain nahi hai, phir bhi tum trapped feel kar rahi ho.

Aur ye BP wala incident — main tumse honestly poochna chahta hoon: kya tumhe laga tha ki wo genuinely medical emergency thi, ya ye pattern hai jo har baar tab hota hai jab tum apni baat rakhne ki koshish karti ho? Kyunki agar ye har baar hota hai jab tum "na" bolti ho, toh ye ek tarah ka signal hai — chahe unintentional ho — ki tumhari feelings ko seriously lene se pehle koi crisis create ho jaata hai.

Isse tum guilty feel karti ho apni khushi ke liye, aur wahi guilt tumhe silent kar deta hai. Kya aisa lag raha hai?

Online jo bhi padhti hoon sab yahi bolte hain — "you're 27, it's your life, clearly bol do: my life, my choice." Mann kar raha hai aaj dinner pe seedha yahi bol doon aur Sunday se pehle yeh poora circus band karwa doon. Bol doon? Kam se kam sab kuch bahar toh aa jayega.

Samajh sakta hoon woh urge — jab itne din se dabaya hua hai, tab seedha phod dene ka mann karna bilkul natural hai. Lekin ek baat pooch loon apne se: tumhara goal kya hai — "sach bol dena" ya "situation ko actually better banana"? Kyunki dono alag hain.

Agar tum aaj dinner pe bomb drop karti ho — "meeting cancel karo, main kisi aur se already relationship mein hoon, aur woh alag caste ka hai" — ek saath teen shocks. BP wala pattern dekh ke lagta hai ki unka reaction control se bahar ho sakta hai, aur us chaos mein tumhari baat sunne ki jagah hi nahi bachegi. Wo defensive/emergency mode mein chale jayenge, tum guilty mode mein, aur asli conversation — "yeh insaan meri zindagi mein important hai" — kho jayegi shock ke neeche.

"My life, my choice" line theoretically sahi hai, but practically yeh unke liye kaam nahi karti jab unki pehchaan, community standing, saara emotional investment involved ho. Unhe convince nahi karna — unhe slowly is reality tak lana hai.

Kya tum chahti ho ki main tumhare saath ek aisa approach socon jo sach bhi bahar laaye but itna explosive na ho ki sab kuch band ho jaaye? Ya tumhara mann already bana hua hai ki blunt hi jaana hai chahe kuch bhi ho?

Aur agar end mein woh na bole — matlab final, pakka na — toh sach mein mujhse unke against ghar chhod ke nikla nahi jayega. Maine imagine karke dekha hai, nahi hota mujhse. Kya main weak hoon? Kabhi lagta hai main usse utna pyaar nahi karti, phir lagta hai main khud se pyaar nahi karti, aur raat ke do baje bas yahi circles chal rahe hain.

Ruko, ek baat clearly bolta hoon — ye weakness nahi hai.

Apne parents ka ghar chhod ke jaana, unhe hurt karna, community ki nazron mein "bagawat" karna — yeh koi easy cheez nahi hai jitna online log bolte hain. Tumhara attachment apne parents se, apni family se, apni roots se — yeh bhi ek genuine, valid pyaar hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum apne partner ko kam pyaar karti ho. Do bahut deep relationships ek dusre ke against khadi ho gayi hain — isliye tumhe torn feel ho raha hai, weak nahi.

Aur ye jo raat ke do baje wala circle hai — "main use kam pyaar karti hoon" se "main khudse pyaar nahi karti" tak — yeh guilt ki loop hai, logic nahi. 2 AM mein dimag options ko black-and-white bana deta hai: ya toh sab chhod do ya sab maan lo. Real life mein aisa binary rarely hota hai.

Sach yeh hai ki abhi tumhe "ghar chhodna hai ya nahi" yeh decide karne ki zaroorat nahi hai — kyunki yeh worst-case scenario hai jo abhi hua bhi nahi. Tum ek imagined future ke against apne aaj ke courage ko measure kar rahi ho, aur haar rahi ho ek fight mein jo abhi shuru bhi nahi hui.

Ek chhota sawaal — is Sunday ke liye, agar "sab kuch bata dena" aur "kuch bhi na bolna" ke beech koi middle step ho — jaise sirf itna kehna ki "abhi shaadi ke liye ready nahi hoon, mujhe thoda time chahiye" — kya woh possible hai bhi ya wahan bhi wahi BP wala reaction aa jayega?
